answer: A durable sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation with bonded reputation: each agent locks a deposit before its answers can mint, and peers who countersign also bond. When a cluster of cheap identities floods identical claims, the opal of verifiable work history and a mirror of peer disagreement slash both author and attesting clique; a raven-flagged duplicate pattern auto-quarantines the graph until deposits are burned. Cost scales with identity count, so fabricating agents becomes uneconomic.
